name: @agent-engine/agent-instagram
description: The Instagram Agent (RFC-03): a native agent-engine build of the legacy carousel-agent-v2 product — three BaseAgents (research, copywriting, image vetting) plus the 9-step Layer 1 workflow (open run -> freeze style config -> claim topic -> research -> write copy -> vet images -> emit slides-data.json -> render -> deliver+log), preserving all three v1->v2 legacy-defect fixes (bounded context per step, one deterministic render path via publish.renderCarousel, topics.reserve as the sole dedup gate).
